title: Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery: The Single Pending Request Rule
content:
Only one waiver request, dispute or compromise offer may be pending on a debt in **Benefit Debts and Overpayment Recovery** at a time. A request is pending until a decision citing it exists. A debtor whose waiver request is pending can withdraw it and offer a compromise instead, but the two are never decided side by side. A new request of any of these kinds is taken only when no earlier one on the same debt is still undecided. A repayment plan request is not affected by this limit.

The test is made per debt, against the requests recorded on that debt.

## Training questions

**A waiver request on the debt has no decision yet. Can a dispute be taken on the same debt?** No — a new waiver request, dispute or compromise offer is taken only when no earlier one on that debt is undecided.

**Does a pending request on one debt stop a request on another debt of the same debtor?** No. The limit applies to requests on the same debt.

**Can a repayment plan request be recorded while a waiver request is pending?** Yes. A repayment plan request is not affected by this limit.

**When does a request stop being pending?** When a decision citing it exists.

| Earlier waiver, dispute or compromise request on the same debt | New waiver, dispute or compromise request |
|---|---|
| None | Taken |
| Every earlier one has a decision citing it | Taken |
| At least one with no decision citing it | Not taken |
